user.title: Overview Extras
user.description: Adds lights-on glow and badges, presence, room power, open doors and windows, media and alerts to the built-in Overview's room cards. After adding, refresh your browser and the mobile app. Use Configure to change settings.

abort.already_configured: Overview Extras is already set up.

init.title: Overview Extras settings
init.description: Changes apply after you refresh the browser or app.

data.show_glow: Glow room cards when lights are on
data.show_presence: Use occupancy and presence sensors for the presence icon
data.area_strip: Status strip at the top of room pages
data.badges: Badges on room cards (in priority order)
data.power_exclude: Power sensors to leave out of room totals

data_description.power_exclude: Use this to stop double counting, for example a circuit meter plus the plugs on that circuit.
data_description.max_badges: Room cards are small; extra badges are dropped.
